description: Reopen token scalar unions beyond two measured failures
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,496 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000-point margin. There have been 77 prior macro-attempts and 651 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0178/micro-0001 at 1,496/99.01%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0179/micro-0001, where a positional union scored 98.97%. Token pairs 92/55 and 93/160 are measured sensitive pairs and remain excluded. Hypothesis: those failures are coordinate-specific, so the next minimum-difference unmeasured token groups can qualify under the much smaller retained model. The helper’s insertion boundary is proactively corrected to the delimiter before QKV_TIED_PAIRS; no candidate condition changes. It adds one ordered token union per official micro-trial with runner-only retention/rollback. Stop at first scored discard/error, no pair, 20 trials, or 25 minutes. This is more informative than extending the zero-yield positional path because token skip-path breadth beyond its second failure has not been tested.
summary: The token skip-path evaluated five ordered unions. Four qualified and reduced the frontier from 1,496 to 1,492 parameters; micro-0005 proposed 1,491, failed qualification, and was rolled back. Outcomes: 4 accepts, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors. Compute used five official migrations/verifications over about 5m40s. Stop reason: first scored discard before the 20-trial/25-minute cap.
